reviews.text:
We recently used Brakefield's Pool Service after purchasing a new home. They cleaned the filters on a Monday, and we closed on the house that Thursday. When we arrived for our final walkthrough, we were shocked to find the pool dark green and filled with algae.
We called Jay to understand what the pool looked like earlier in the week, and he said it looked fine. We asked if he could help address the issue, but he wasn’t available until the following week. He suggested that the pool could likely be fixed with about $40 in chemicals.
When he did come out the next Wednesday, we were disappointed not only by the lack of urgency but also by his dismissive and condescending attitude. He recommended a pool care book he referred to as “pools for dummies,” which we felt was unprofessional and unhelpful given the situation.
Since then, we’ve spent thousands of dollars addressing the algae issue and making necessary equipment repairs. We hoped for more support and guidance during a stressful transition into our new home, but unfortunately, our experience with Brakefield’s left a lot to be desired.

Edit in response to business reply:
Thank you for taking the time to respond. I’d like to clarify a few key points to ensure an accurate understanding of our experience.
The visit to our property did not last two hours. While we appreciated that it was provided free of charge, the support offered during that time felt limited.
We were told that someone would return to address a malfunctioning booster pump, but we never received any follow-up communication - no calls, texts, or emails - after that conversation.
We did not request educational resources on pool care. Our goal was to find experienced professionals who could help resolve the condition of the pool after move-in. The suggestion to buy a book on pool care that was referred to as "pools for dummies", regardless of intent, did not feel appropriate in the moment given the situation.
My review was not about assigning blame for the algae. We understand that pool conditions can change quickly, especially during a transition of ownership. My intent was simply to share our firsthand experience with the level of responsiveness and support we received during a very stressful time.
I recognize that critical reviews are never easy to receive, but I hope you can also understand how the situation felt from the customer’s side. We were hoping for a more engaged and solutions-oriented approach and were disappointed with how things were handled.
reviews.author: Renee Golobay

reviews.text:
After getting quotes from 3 others local pool services companies, we decided to go with Brakefield's Pool Service. The quoted price was reasonable and fair.
While repairs were being done there was an additional issue discovered, they quickly notified us and performed the extra repair...right then!! Amazing!
Jay came and did the final inspection, pool cleanup, timer resets and even took his time to explain some pool maintenance basics. Something most companies do not do now a days, well done Brakefield!
I would highly recommend their services to anyone who is need of any pool repair or maintenance.
reviews.author: Dave Mogavero

reviews.text:
I recently had the pleasure of working with Brakefield Pool Service, and I cannot recommend them highly enough. From start to finish, Jay Brakefield and his team provided an exceptional experience that exceeded all my expectations.

From the moment of contact, I was impressed by their professionalism and attention to detail. Jay himself took the time to understand my needs and provided a comprehensive plan tailored specifically to my pool's requirements. His knowledge and expertise were evident, and he patiently answered all my questions, ensuring I felt comfortable and informed every step of the way.

The team arrived promptly as scheduled and demonstrated an impressive level of efficiency and skill. It was clear that Jay has instilled a strong work ethic and commitment to quality in his team. They meticulously cleaned and serviced my pool, leaving it sparkling and pristine. What truly stood out was their dedication to not just meeting, but exceeding, industry standards.

Jay and his team were courteous and respectful throughout the entire process. They took great care to ensure that the surrounding areas were left tidy and undisturbed, which I greatly appreciated. Their friendly demeanor made the experience all the more pleasant, and it was clear that customer satisfaction is their top priority.

In addition to their outstanding service, they were able to offer competitive pricing, providing excellent value for the level of service delivered. I am thrilled with the results and have complete confidence in their ability to maintain my pool in peak condition.

In closing, this is a company that truly stands out in the pool service industry. Their professionalism, expertise, and dedication to customer satisfaction make them a top choice for anyone in need of pool maintenance or service. I look forward to continuing to work with them and highly recommend their services to anyone seeking a reliable and outstanding pool service provider.
reviews.author: Riley Lappin

reviews.text: When I had an emergency come up with my pool I contacted Jay with Brakefield's Pool Service late in the evening and he responded by coming out ASAP and spending two hours helping me fix my pool and getting it in working order. Jay gives you a fair price for such excellent service and no pesky annual contract - he even goes above and beyond what both of our previous "chain" Pool Service companies have done for a more competitive price. He shows up reliably every week and literally just lets me and my family focus on enjoying our pool, I can't recommend him and his company enough. Even if it's just for a single service or repair, Jay's your man!
reviews.author: Kevin Gomes

reviews.text: Jay is by all means as good as they come when you need a reliable pool company! I appreciate their rapid response, fair pricing, and high level of service. Jay has been nothing short of a true professional and I highly recommend his pool service for anyone in the Denton area! 5 stars all the way!!!!
reviews.author: Bruce Burns

reviews.text:
On Monday, July 17, 2023 - a Brakefield technician came and serviced our pool at 5:30 PM.

At 7:30 PM I went outside ready for a swim only to be confronted with black spots in the bottom of my pool. At first I thought it was algae so I tried to scrub one of the spots. It didn’t come off, nor was there any change to the spot. This was concerning to me so I texted Jay Brakefield himself. I was immediately met with defensiveness, denial, and unfounded accusations against myself. At the end of the conversation, he “fired” my husband and I. We have been clients for 5 years and NEVER have we made any complaints or accusations against the company. I’m attaching photos of the spots and unedited screenshots of the conversation.

***We reported them to the BBB and they never responded to them either.
reviews.author: Sonya Smith

reviews.text: We do appreciate your care and concern about our pool. You take great care of It and we will do the best we can to help keep it as pristine as y’all do.  Please know we understand and hope all goes well🙏🏻
reviews.author: Saundra Jeannequin

reviews.text: Jay is the best! He's very knowledgeable and reliable, super easy to work with and goes the extra mile every time. Highly recomend!
reviews.author: Gelu Silav
